title: Water Street, 1893
text:
Edith Fixture came to Harbor Town from Ohio in 1890. In March 1893 she wrote to her sister: “I have bought the lot on Water Street and mean to build before the rains.” The men at the mill told her that a woman could not keep a house of twenty boarders.

That year she opened her boarding house on Water Street. It cost four hundred dollars.
